verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. Both materializers now compile their cached rule sets and assemble/validate all input facts before the first mutation of the caller's Graph; reserved graphs are excluded during assembly itself, and strip_reserved_graphs runs only after successful evaluation. The new regression test is non-vacuous: it first creates a non-empty authorization view, injects an invalid reserved principal through the real WAC and ACP assembly paths, observes Err, and verifies the prior view remains unchanged. The compiled-vs-text differentials compare non-empty installed authorization views for WAC, ACP, and ACP provenance, while the direct-fact round-trip test checks the shared fact adapter. No new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue is evident in the diff-scoped evidence.
